entries.jsdocSummary: Enables autocompletion for a union type, while keeping the ability to use any string or type of `T`

entries.name: Lazy
entries.signature: export type Lazy<T> = T | (() => T);
entries.jsdocSummary: A value or a zero-arg thunk producing it — the deferred-config shape DOT adapters accept so a declaration can reference env without observing it at module load: `kv(() => ({ url: env.REDIS_URL }))`. The adapter calls {@link resolveLazy} at boot, which is where the observation belongs.

entries.name: lazyObject
entries.signature: export declare function lazyObject<T extends object>(build: () => T): T;
entries.jsdocSummary: Defer an object's construction to its FIRST property access, memoized.

entries.name: Nullable
entries.signature: export type Nullable<T, K extends keyof T> = { [P in keyof T]: P extends K ? T[P] | null : T[P]; };

entries.name: once
entries.signature: export declare function once<T>(compute: () => T): () => T;
entries.jsdocSummary: Memoize a zero-argument computation: `compute` runs on the FIRST call, every later call returns the same result — including `undefined` (the guard is a flag, not the value). Works for async computations too, since memoizing a promise-returning function memoizes the promise itself.

entries.name: PathValue
entries.signature: export type PathValue<T, P extends PathCheck<T, P>> = P extends `${infer Key}.${infer Rest}` ? Key extends keyof T ? IsNestedPath<T[Key], Rest> extends true ? ValueAt<T[Key], Rest> : Rest extends RecordToPath<T[Key]> ? PathValue<T[Key], Rest> : never : never : P extends keyof T ? T[P] : never;
entries.jsdocSummary: Used to read the value of a string path inside an object defined as const const obj = { a: { b: 'hello' }} as const; type Value = PathValue<typeof obj, 'a.b'> Value is now a union set containing a single type: 'hello'

entries.name: Prettify
entries.signature: export type Prettify<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K]; } & {};
entries.jsdocSummary: `Prettify`: flatten an intersection so the IDE shows one resolved object type.

entries.name: RecordToPath
entries.signature: export type RecordToPath<T> = PathImpl<T, keyof T> | keyof T;
entries.jsdocSummary: Used to construct a type union containing all the keys (even if nested) of an object defined as const const obj = { a: { b: '' }, c: '' } as const; type Paths = RecordToPath<typeof obj> Paths contains: 'a' | 'a.b' | 'c'

entries.name: resolveLazy
entries.signature: export declare function resolveLazy<T>(value: Lazy<T>): T;
entries.jsdocSummary: Resolve a {@link Lazy}: call it if it is a thunk, return it otherwise.

entries.name: Serializable
entries.signature: export type Serializable<T> = { [K in keyof T as IsSerializable<T[K]> extends true ? K : never]: T[K]; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Excludes any non-serializable prop from an object

entries.name: SnakeToCamel
entries.signature: export type SnakeToCamel<T> = T extends `${infer A}_${infer B}` ? `${Uncapitalize<A>}${Capitalize<SnakeToCamel<B>>}` : T extends object ? { [K in keyof T as SnakeToCamel<K>]: T[K]; } : T;
entries.jsdocSummary: Helper types for casing (`SnakeToCamel`, `CamelToSnake`), paths (`RecordToPath`, `PathValue`) and object shapes (`DeepPartial`, `Nullable`, `Without`).

entries.jsdocSummary: Omit without union flattening

entries.name: expectImportPure
entries.signature: export declare function expectImportPure(entryPaths: readonly string[], options?: ImportPurityOptions): void;
entries.jsdocSummary: Assert the composition doctrine's import-purity contract: importing the given modules must succeed from a bare checkout with a scrubbed environment (only `PATH`/`HOME` for the runtime itself).

entries.name: ImportPurityOptions
entries.signature: export type ImportPurityOptions = { /** Subprocess runtime binary (default `'bun'`). */ readonly runtime?: string; /** Kill the subprocess after this long (default 60s). */ readonly timeoutMs?: number; /** * Extra environment variables for the subprocess, merged over the scrubbed * base. Use sparingly — every var added here is a purity exemption. */ readonly env?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Options for {@link expectImportPure}.
